headers: Supplier Response: Please detail how Supplier's proposed products are able to provide each of the items listed in Column B if that line is marked as a REQUIRED in column C.            NOTE:  If the item is marked as OPTIONAL in column D, please provide information about how Supplier's proposed products are able to provide those functions/has the capability to provide the item listed per line, if capable of providing this. Additionally, some lines are just asking for specific information.  Please provide a response for ALL LINES .
sample: Describe in detail the types of user roles and levels of permissions/access supported in the system for administrative use (i.e. dispatchers, supervisors, managers, administrative staff).
Describe in detail what, if any, imports are supported in the system. Such as, importing route schedule data, programming bus stops, etc.

Describe in detail the types of "playback" or historical queries that can be used by transit staff to investigate incidents, such as investigating the specific time a vehicle was at a location in the past. Include whether the queries can be made by run, bus number, route group, or entire system. Include how far back in time the system can query this type data.
